claim: The 256-token chunks achieve better recall for questions seeking a specific date, role, or condition.
evidence: Chunks of 256 and 512 tokens were compared with 15% overlap.

claim: The 512-token chunks perform better on multi-hop questions that need to combine a general rule with an exception located in the same section.
evidence: Chunks of 256 and 512 tokens were compared with 15% overlap.

claim: The main baseline will retain 256 tokens because it maximizes coverage.
evidence: Hybrid-system results on the development set are recall@10 of 0.81 with 256 and 0.79 with 512; MRR is 0.63 and 0.65 respectively.
